preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= k for x in alice_fish) and all(1 <= x <= k for x in bob_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types in Alice's and Bob's catches are integers between 1 and k (inclusive).
Input constraints: n and m are the counts of fish caught by Alice and Bob (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 10^5), and k is the number of fish species (1 ≤ k ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(sum(alice_counts[x] * w[x] for x in range(1, k+1)) > sum(bob_counts[x] * w[x] for x in range(1, k+1)) for w in possible_weights(alice_fish, bob_fish)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists a strictly increasing sequence of weights w[1] ≤ w[2] ≤ ... ≤ w[k] (with w[i] > 0) such that the total weight of Alice's fish is strictly greater than Bob's. Otherwise, output 'NO'.
